fact: The KWiK roadmap foresees payments to the State, among other functions, through the Multicaixa network.
The UN Global Survey 2025 round reports electronic payment of customs duties in Angola as partially implemented.
Expansao reports that RUPE, a 20-digit reference generated through the AGT system, is in service for paying taxes, fees and state services, with 12.5 million operations in 2025.
Expansao, from EMIS data, calculates that about Kz 6.7 trillion, roughly 36% of Kz 18.9 trillion current revenue, was paid through RUPE in 2025, excluding oil taxes.
Angola's AGT directed that payment of taxes be made electronically as a general rule through the Portal do Contribuinte, with office help only where internet access or digital literacy is lacking.
